defs.def: something that you feel through the mind or through the senses （内心和感官的）感觉，感触

ex.s: Mum is small, but I remember feeling so high up there.
ex.t: 妈妈个子很小，但我记得在那里感觉好高啊。

ex.s: Packing up my parents’ house felt like a massive goodbye — that bedroom, those memories, the feeling of safety and shelter I always felt there.
ex.t: 收拾父母家的房子感觉像一场盛大的告别——那间卧室、那些记忆、我在那里始终感到的安全和庇护。

ex.s: Maybe that feeling comes from growing up in South Africa, where the phrase “there are children starving in Africa” was more of an uncomfortable reminder of fact than a prayer at dinner time.
ex.t: 也许那种感觉源于在南非长大，在那里，“非洲有儿童在挨饿”这句话与其说是一句餐前祈祷，不如说是对现实令人不安的提醒。

ex.s: In her study, Martin asked participants to rate their attachment to male, female, and genderless versions of a digital voice assistant and a self-driving car known as “Miuu.” It was found that gender increased users’ feelings of attachment to these devices and their interest in purchasing them.
ex.t: 在Martin的研究中，她让参与者对一款名为“Miuu”的数字语音助手和自动驾驶汽车的有性别、女性、无性别版本评价自己的依恋程度。研究发现，性别增强了用户对这些设备的依恋感以及购买兴趣。

ex.s: Completing many courses no longer brings out the feeling of success because more than four AP classes per year is a norm set by top universities.
ex.t: 完成许多课程不再带来成功感，因为每年超过四门AP课已是顶尖大学设定的常态。

ex.s: The feeling of success was no longer attached to what grade I received but to the pure joy of learning.
ex.t: 成功的感觉不再与我所获得的分数挂钩，而是与学习的纯粹乐趣相连。

ex.s: A feeling of helplessness washed over me as I saw the bus queue thinning out.
ex.t: 当我看到排队等巴士的人越来越少，一种无助感涌上心头。

ex.s: We are tempted by sugary treats because our ancestors lived in a calorie-poor world, and our brains developed a response mechanism to these treats that reflected their value — a feeling of reward and satisfaction.
ex.t: 我们会被含糖零食诱惑，因为我们的祖先生活在热量匮乏的世界里，而我们的大脑形成了一种对这些零食的响应机制，反映出它们的价值——一种奖励和满足感。

ex.s: Feeling desperate, Eva started using a mind trick on herself.
ex.t: 感到绝望的伊娃开始对自己使用心理技巧。

ex.s: If you have individuals who are not on board, your words probably won’t do much and can often leave you feeling more discouraged.
ex.t: 如果有不支持你的人，你说的话可能起不了多大作用，而且往往让你更加沮丧。

ex.s: At the end of each session I return home feeling stronger, lighter, more able to carry on.
ex.t: 每次课程结束时，我回到家感觉更强壮、更轻松，更能继续下去。

ex.s: He believes bus drivers are the eyes and ears of students when they're away from home and they have a gift to discern what kids are feeling.
ex.t: 他认为，当学生们离家在外时，公交车司机就是他们的眼睛和耳朵，并且他们有一种辨别孩子们感受的天赋。

ex.s: “He’s interested in the music, feeling every note, and I have to say: ‘Turn, turn!’ “Robert is the best page turner I’ve had in my entire life.”
ex.t: "他对音乐很投入，感受每一个音符，而我不得不说：'翻页！翻页！'罗伯特是我一生中遇到过的最好的翻谱员。"

ex.t: 这种感觉也会导致许多其他健康问题。

ex.t: 我们是在书本、电脑、高速公路和手机的环境中长大的，但现在却住在一个没有自来水和电的村庄。一天结束时，我们带着一点不被理解的感觉入睡是很容易的事。

ex.t: 它们让人们百感交集。

ex.s: “There’s a certain feeling that giving can do for you and that was apparent in those that gave the most." Most people who took dollars took only a few, but Bridges said a very small number took as much as they could.
ex.t: "给予能给人带来一种特定的感觉，这在那些给得最多的人身上表现得非常明显。"大多数拿钱的人只拿了几张，但布里奇斯说有极少数人尽可能多地拿。

ex.s: Friendship soup Like any good soup, This won’t fail to make you smile when you’re feeling down.
ex.t: 友谊汤 就像任何好汤一样，当你心情低落时，它必定会让你露出微笑。

ex.s: While I was concentrating on photographing this amazing scene, I suddenly had a feeling that I was being watched.
ex.t: 当我专注于拍摄这个令人惊叹的场景时，我突然觉得自己被监视了。

ex.s: He or she is the person who is feeling the weight of that awkwardness the most
ex.t: 他或她，就是最能感受到那份尴尬之沉重的人。

ex.s: This is how a piece of art makes you feel, and whether or not you appreciate or enjoy that feeling.
ex.t: 这是一件艺术品带给你的感受，以及你是否欣赏或享受那种感觉。

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日，那天我们为收集物资付出的所有努力终于汇聚在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要制作的每一个套装最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作这些套装的过程中，我意识到自己已经忽略了它背后的真正意义——我只顾着把它当成又一个学校项目，而且是我想要拿高分的一个。当这些套装制作完成、准备送往海外时，那种温暖的感觉我将永远铭记。

ex.s: "That was my home． I was a teenager sitting in the hall． Before you came over， I never realized what a beautiful place I lived in． I never felt lucky before． You thought it was a museum． My feelings about my home changed after that． I've always wanted to thank you．"
ex.t: “那是我家。我当时是个坐在厅里的少年。你来之前，我从没意识到自己住的地方多美。我以前从没觉得自己幸运。你以为那是博物馆。从那以后我对家的感觉变了。我一直想谢谢你。”

ex.s: I woke up most mornings with a dull, grey feeling as I forced myself out of bed to start the day.
ex.t: 大多数早晨我醒来时都带着一种沉闷、灰暗的感觉，强迫自己起床开始新的一天。

ex.s: Anger is a particularly strong feeling and maybe people think that they have reasons to feel angry.
ex.t: 愤怒是一种特别强烈的感觉，也许人们会认为他们有理由感到愤怒。

defs.def: the idea or belief that a particular thing is true or a particular situation is likely to happen 想法；看法；信念

ex.s: I’d like to know what you think of your new school, and how you’re feeling about it.
ex.t: 我想知道你对你新学校的看法，以及你对它的感受。

defs.def: an attitude or opinion about sth 态度；意见

ex.s: “Boasting about yourself，and your best qualities,” Whaley says，“is very difficult for a child who came into the classroom not feeling confident.”
ex.t: “夸自己，夸自己的优点，”惠利说，“对一个走进教室时毫无自信的孩子来说，是非常困难的。”

defs.def: a person's emotions rather than their thoughts or ideas 情感；感情

ex.s: Across all participants, those in the beauty group reported an average of 23% higher levels of “transformative and self-transcendent feelings” — such as feeling moved, enlightened and inspired — than the control group.
ex.t: 在所有参与者中，“美”组报告的“蜕变与超越自我的感受”——如感动、顿悟和受启发——平均比对照组高出23%。

ex.s: Dancing seems to change their feeling completely.
ex.t: 跳舞似乎彻底改变了他们的感受。

ex.s: For all the feelings readers attach to stories, literature is a numbers game, and the test of time is extremely difficult to pass.
ex.t: 尽管读者对故事倾注诸多情感，文学终究是一场数字游戏，而时间的考验极难通过。

ex.s: Anger seems simple when we are feeling it, but the causes of anger are various.
ex.t: 在我们感受愤怒时，愤怒看似简单，但引起愤怒的原因却多种多样。

ex.s: How people dress has an influence on their feelings
ex.t: 人们的穿着方式会影响他们的感受。

ex.s: Keep the room cool rather than warm to avoid feeling sleepy.
ex.t: 保持房间凉爽而不是温暖，以避免犯困。

ex.s: Azimi says study participants tended not to trust reviews where the writers expressed their feelings in a big way.
ex.t: Azimi说，研究参与者往往不相信那些作家们以很大方式表达其感情的评论。

ex.s: Emotional states of participants were also measured by asking about their feelings while completing the gallery task.
ex.t: 参与者的情绪状态也通过询问他们在完成画廊任务时的感受来衡量。

ex.s: With these main reasons in mind, we can evaluate our level of anger throughout the day and prevent cases of outbursts by comprehending the reasons for our feelings.

ex.s: Importantly, however, the beauty group did not report feeling any happier than the control group, suggesting that it was the engagement with beauty that influenced abstract thinking, rather than any overall positivity from the experience.
ex.t: 然而重要的是，美感组并没有报告比对照组更快乐，这表明影响抽象思维的是与美的接触，而不是这次经历带来的整体积极情绪。

ex.s: But by learning healthier ways to manage emotions, you can regain control over the food you eat and your feelings.
ex.t: 但通过学习更健康的方式来管理情绪，你可以重新控制自己的饮食和情绪。

defs.def: the ability to understand sb/sth or to do sth in a sensitive way 理解力；领悟力；敏感

ex.s: Understanding others’ feelings.
ex.t: 理解他人的感受。

ex.s: The ability to accurately understand how others are feeling may be used by a doctor to find how best to help her patients, while a cheater might use it to control potential victims.
ex.t: 准确理解他人感受的能力，医生可以用来找到最好地帮助病人的方法，而骗子可能用它来控制潜在受害者。

ex.s: sensitive to others' feelings
ex.t: B．对他人的感受敏感

defs.def: sympathy or love for sb/sth 同情；爱
the ability to feel physically 身体感觉；知觉

ex.s: If you haven't been feeling very well, drink some ginger tea to give your immune system a helping hand.
ex.t: 如果你身体一直不太好，喝点姜茶来增强你的免疫系统。

defs.def: the atmosphere of a place, situation, etc. （场所、情况等给人的）气氛

ex.s: Comparing yourself with someone who is outperforming you could result in feelings of envy if you focus on the things they have and you don’t, or it can be energizing and inspiring if you use these comparisons as a source of motivation, for example, “If they can achieve that, so can I.” Comparing yourself with someone who is doing worse than you could result in fear and worry if you think about how you could fall into similar circumstances, or it can draw out feelings of gratitude and appreciation if you use that comparison to broaden your views — for example, “Wow, things could be much worse; I’m doing great.”
ex.t: 把自己和表现优于你的人比较，如果你盯着他们有而你没有的东西，可能产生嫉妒；但如果你把这些比较当作动力来源，比如“他们能做到，我也能”，它就会令人振奋和鼓舞。把自己和不如你的人比较，如果你想到自己也可能陷入类似境地，可能产生恐惧和担忧；但如果你用这种比较拓宽视角，比如“哇，情况可能更糟，我已经很不错了”，它就会引发感恩和知足。

ex.s: On a regular day， students at the school sometimes come up to him to say they're not feeling well or other times to tell him about something that happened at break． He knows most of the kids at the school， but can't name each one． Some of them make him know them． Like Faith， who often forgets her backpack in the cafeteria， and Lucy， who just wants a hug．
ex.t: 平常的一天，学校里的学生有时会走到他面前说他们不舒服，有时则会告诉他课间发生的事。他认识学校里大多数孩子，却叫不出每个人的名字。有些孩子让他记住了自己，比如常常把背包忘在食堂的Faith，还有只想拥抱一下的Lucy。
